description: Port of Los Angeles - ADP Project is a dataset listed in City of Los Angeles open data portal (data.lacity.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Los Angeles. Port of Los Angeles - Application for Discretionary Permit (ADP) Project. Coverage: Los Angeles. The portal files it under the category City Infrastructure & Service Requests. Its tags are permit. The table has 40 columns. Attribution on the portal: Port of Los Angeles. The portal shows 2015-04-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-lacity-org-portal.
